events.address: Madison Square Park, southeast corner near 23rd St & Madison Ave, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: IBM's free US Open Championship Weekend fan hub with AI-powered tennis activations, match viewing, a serve-speed simulator, AI-enabled ping pong and an AI photo booth.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fan experience and listed activations is free. IBM also advertises giveaways, but no specific giveaway is guaranteed to every visitor.
events.caveats: The free experience is in Madison Square Park, not inside the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center. Merchandise and any giveaways are subject to their own availability or purchase terms.
events.practical_notes: IBM's official newsroom gives date-specific public hours for all four days. No RSVP or approval step is stated for entry to the park activation.

events.what_it_is: Renggli's first pop-up, presented with Vivrelle, combining Renggli's Fall 2026 collection with Vivrelle designer handbags and jewelry available to borrow or buy.
events.what_is_free: Free public access to browse the NYFW pop-up. Merchandise, borrowing and membership services have their own purchase or membership terms; no take-home giveaway is promised.
events.caveats: The pop-up is public-facing, but borrowing Vivrelle pieces requires Vivrelle membership and merchandise purchases are optional retail transactions.
events.practical_notes: Vivrelle's current site and its issued press release both confirm September 10–13, 11 AM–7 PM at 76 Wooster Street.

events.address: Channel Gardens, Rockefeller Center, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112
events.what_it_is: A limited-time GapBags pop-up featuring the new Five-Pocket Tote, on-site customization, charms, accessories and limited-edition artist-designed drops.
events.what_is_free: Public access to browse the pop-up is free. Bags, customization products and merchandise are retail items unless specifically stated otherwise on site.
events.caveats: The official page says the pop-up is open to the public. Limited-edition artist drops and customization inventory may be quantity-limited; no free bag is promised.
events.practical_notes: Rockefeller Center confirms September 11–13, 10 AM–6 PM daily in Channel Gardens.

events.event_name: KAY Jewelers Love All In Mobile Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A mobile Love All In confessional-style activation with mini-games, interactive prompts, a selfie station and stylized bedazzled photo strips.
events.what_is_free: Public participation and the photo-strip/selfie experience are advertised as free. Confessional participants can enter a diamond sweepstakes, but winning is not guaranteed.
events.caveats: This is a mobile activation with different locations on different dates. Sweepstakes entry is a chance to win, not a guaranteed diamond or giveaway.
events.practical_notes: September 10 is at the Starrett-Lehigh Building on 26th Street at 11th Avenue, 6:30–8:30 PM. September 12 is on West Broadway between Prince and Spring, 11 AM–8 PM.
